snippet.title: Northanda Chronicles - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Master role-based deckbuilding in Northanda Chronicles, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Build a party around the RPG holy trinity from countless hero combinations, craft a shared deck with powerful synergies, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2068650/Northanda_Chronicles
